rationale: The agent verified the user via email lookup and user details, limiting actions to the authenticated account. It pulled both order details, confirmed eligibility (delivered), and clearly stated the exact changes (return all items, refunds to original payment methods). The agent asked for explicit confirmation before making any changes; the user confirmed proceeding with original payment methods after asking about cross-refunds. The agent then executed the returns correctly using the proper item IDs and original payment methods, and reported accurate post-action information (returns submitted, follow-up emails). No unsupported claims or actions on another account, and no writes without confirmation. Minor omission of explaining why cross-refund isn’t possible did not affect compliance since the user agreed to proceed with original methods before the writes.
